We look forward to seeing your portfolio and learning how you'd approach ANKRid's next chapter.

job.description:
Brand Identity & Visual Designer for ANKRid (HealthTech Startup)

Website: https://ankrid.com

The marketing website and authenticated owner/provider portals have already been redesigned with a premium, modern SaaS aesthetic, and we plan to keep that overall design language. This project is focused on creating a brand identity that elevates and complements that redesign—not redesigning the website or application itself.

The successful designer will create a visual identity that feels native to the existing experience and is consistent across the marketing site, owner portal, provider portal, and future mobile applications.

About ANKRid

We're building something that doesn't exist today.

ANKRid is a patent-pending HealthTech startup creating the world's first permanent universal digital identity for animals—allowing health records to securely follow an animal throughout its lifetime instead of remaining trapped inside individual veterinary systems.

Think of us as digital infrastructure for animal healthcare—not another veterinary software platform.

Our mission is simple:

One Identity. Every Record. Every Provider.

We're looking for an experienced Brand Identity Designer to help create a visual identity that reflects where the company is headed.

What We're Looking For

We're not looking for someone to simply make us a logo.

We're looking for someone to help build a modern, premium technology brand.

Our inspiration comes from companies like:

Stripe
Linear
Vercel
Mercury
Ramp
Apple
Notion

We love brands that feel:

Clean
Sophisticated
Modern
Confident
Minimal
Timeless
Premium

We're intentionally moving away from traditional veterinary branding.

This should feel like a technology company that just happens to serve animal healthcare.

Our Current Redesign Direction

We're redesigning our website and application around:

Large amounts of white space
Premium typography
Elegant layouts
Navy, white, and cyan accents
Clean enterprise SaaS interfaces
Minimalistic design
Calm, trustworthy user experience

The current logo no longer reflects that direction.

We're looking for a complete evolution of the brand.

Scope of Work

We're looking for someone to design:

Primary Logo

A modern, timeless wordmark.

Secondary Logo

Alternative layouts for different applications.

Brand Icon

A memorable icon that works as:

App icon
Favicon
Social media profile image
Browser tab
Mobile application
Color Palette

A refined technology-focused color system.

Typography

Recommendations for modern fonts that complement the new identity.

Brand Guidelines

A concise guide covering:

Logo usage
Spacing
Colors
Typography
Light and dark versions
Minimum sizing
Icon usage
Social Sharing Assets

Including a polished Open Graph image so that when someone shares ANKRid.com, it looks like a premium startup rather than just displaying a logo.

Deliverables

Please include:

SVG
AI
EPS
PDF
PNG
Transparent PNGs
Monochrome versions
Light and dark versions
Favicon
App icon
Social preview graphics
Brand guideline document
Please Avoid

We're intentionally avoiding designs built around common veterinary clichés such as:

Paw prints
Hearts
Stethoscopes
Cartoon animals
Mascots
Generic healthcare symbols
Clip art
AI-generated logos

Our product is infrastructure.

The brand should communicate trust, permanence, technology, and simplicity.

Ideal Experience

We're especially interested in designers who have worked on branding for:

SaaS
HealthTech
FinTech
Enterprise software
B2B technology startups

If you've created brands that feel polished, modern, and scalable, we'd love to see your work.

To Apply

Please include:

• Your portfolio.
• Three branding projects you're most proud of.
• Which technology company's branding do you admire most, and why?
• What would you do to make ANKRid feel like it belongs alongside companies such as Stripe, Linear, Mercury, or Apple while still maintaining its own unique identity?

We look forward to seeing your portfolio and learning how you'd approach ANKRid's next chapter.

siblingJobs.description: About ANKRid ANKRid is a patent-pending startup building the first universal digital health passport for animals. Today, an animal's medical records are often scattered across veterinary clinics, emergency hospitals, specialists, shelters, groomers, trainers, boarding facilities, and other providers. ANKRid is solving that problem by creating one secure, lifelong digital identity that allows authorized health records to follow the animal wherever they go. We're an early-stage startup with a working product demo, growing early interest, and an ambitious vision to modernize how animal records are shared across the animal healthcare industry. Learn more about ANKRid here: https://ankrid.com Please take a few minutes to review our website before submitting your proposal. Applicants who demonstrate an understanding of our mission and product will be given preference. About the Role We're looking for an experienced Business Development & Sales Representative to become an extension of our team. This is not a scripted telemarketing position. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building relationships, learning innovative products, and representing an early-stage startup with professionalism and enthusiasm. We're looking for someone who is excited to learn our business, understand our product, and confidently represent ANKRid to veterinary clinics, hospitals, shelters, groomers, trainers, boarding facilities, and other animal care organizations. During onboarding, you'll work directly with me to learn our mission, product, live demo, messaging, common objections, and sales process. Once you're comfortable, you'll conduct outreach, schedule meetings, present our interactive product demo, answer common questions, build relationships with prospective providers, and help guide organizations through the early stages of becoming ANKRid partners. As ANKRid grows, you'll also help identify and initiate conversations with Practice Information Management System (PIMS) vendors to explore strategic integration opportunities that could make it easier for veterinary practices and other animal healthcare clinics to use ANKRid alongside the software they already rely on. We want someone who wants to become knowledgeable about our business—not simply read from a script. You'll have the opportunity to play an important role in helping shape how we introduce ANKRid to the animal healthcare industry.
